rows.ARS:
Deep pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Elizabeth Taylor
rows.Origin: Bred by Von C. Weddle (United States, 1985).
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, darker edges. Flowers deep pink with smoky edges. Mild to strong, spice fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, exhibition, high-centered, reflexed bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Medium, long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, upright. Large, semi-glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 5' to 6' (150 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Very vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 6,492 on 27 Dec 1988 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Notes: Elizabeth Taylor was born on February 27, 1932.

colour: Deep pink, darker edges. Flowers deep pink with smoky edges.
